mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates compress equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as accommodative policy supports risk asset valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS below 0.25%, with t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return difference versus baseline.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS falling below 0.25% signals aggressive monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as investors anticipate sustained liquidity support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline signal a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to generate positive 60-day returns in >60% of instances, or interaction term coefficient negative with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth slowing but HOUST strong), S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns as resilient consumer demand offsets growth deceleration.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in >60% of late-cycle expansion periods (GDPC1 growth < 2.0% and HOUST > 1000), or regime-specific return not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, correlating with positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as corporate profits rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of INDPRO above 12-month moving average periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeding 2.5% signals inflationary pressure triggering monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL YoY >2.5% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0%), S&P 500 experiences negative returns over 5 days as higher rates reduce equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in >60% of monetary tightening cycle periods (FEDFUNDS rising >0.5% in 3 months), or regime-specific return not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE falling below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of UNRATE <4.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
